about: Fixed station hardware of the as-surveyed map and the stowage units' last registered positions, in the station frame. Positions are survey values to 0.01 m, directions unit vectors to 3 decimals. Return inlets: centre of the opening face, normal into the cabin, long and short axes of the opening. Crew handrails: centre, bar axis, direction away from the wall. Stowage units: the wall they are on, the rack location code of that bay (null when the unit is not on a coded bay), the mount point on the wall under the holding screen's centre, the face normal into the cabin, pad_axis (from pouch pad P1 toward P2) and cross_axis (normal cross pad_axis), the screen and pouch pad faces (centre of the opening in the face plane), the fiducial plates with their plate frames (x = long side, z = normal into the cabin, y = z cross x; fly_rel goals are given in this frame) and the approach zone (an oriented box: centre, axes, half sizes). Dock: its fiducial plate, its approach zone and, for each berth, the approach pose from which the firmware berths.
